scripts.text:
[Merito]
You packed so much in your bag. Try again after emptying your bag.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
你的背包里装得太满了。请先清空背包再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Please get on with the sprits well~ You should~!
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
请好好对待精灵们~ 你应该做到的~！

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Wow~ you are a young adventurer. I envy you.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
哇~ 你是一位年轻的冒险者。真让人羡慕啊。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Ahh~ I think you don't need to have a conversation with me.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
啊~ 看来你不需要和我聊天呢。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Welcome. What can I help you with?
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
欢迎光临。有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Good, then I'll give you a short explanation about the Sorcerer.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
很好，那我就简单介绍一下妖术师吧。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
How about your test? Well, Karacas is a little lazy, so that might bother you some... kkk
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
你的测试感觉如何？嗯，卡拉卡斯有点懒散，这可能会让你有点困扰... kkk

scripts.text: Do you know about Sorcerers?
scripts.translation: 你了解妖术师吗？

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Wouldn't it be more comfortable to just live as a scholar? Sorcerers are busy communicating with the spirits and don't have much time to read books...
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
作为学者生活不是更舒适吗？妖术师忙着与精灵交流，没多少时间读书...

scripts.text:
[Merito]
What made you want to be a sorcerer?
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
是什么让你想成为妖术师的？

scripts.text: The spirit of fire led me here.
scripts.translation: 火之精灵指引我来到这里。

scripts.text: The spirit of water led me here.
scripts.translation: 水之精灵指引我来到这里。

scripts.text: The spirit of earth led me here
scripts.translation: 土之精灵指引我来到这里。

scripts.text: The spirit of meat led me here.
scripts.translation: 肉之精灵指引我来到这里。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
That kind of spirit doesn't exist!
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
那种精灵根本不存在！

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Oh, I see.
You must be born with the natural ability to see that you already communicated with the spirits, or you must be an excellent liar.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
哦，我明白了。
你要么天生就有与精灵沟通的能力，要么就是个大骗子。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Hmm... Then first, can you write down your name on this list?
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
嗯... 那么首先，你能在这个名单上写下你的名字吗？

scripts.text: Write name.
scripts.translation: 写下名字

scripts.text: I won't.
scripts.translation: 我不写

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Well, okay. See you again when you get a chance.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
好吧。有机会再见面吧。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
So, you are [{0}].
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
原来你就是[{0}]啊。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Give me a second to register your name.
Talk to me again in a second.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
请稍等，我要登记一下你的名字。
过一会儿再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
[{0}], can you handle magic skillfully?
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
[{0}]，你能熟练地使用魔法吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I can.
scripts.translation: 是的，我可以。

scripts.text: No, I'm not really good at it.
scripts.translation: 不，我不太擅长。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
What!? You don't know how to use magic?
What are you doing here then? Get out of here. Right now!
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
什么！你连魔法都不会用？
那你来这里干什么？马上给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Okay, that should be obvious.
Of course, Sorcerers use magic, too. But, do you know the main difference Sorcerers have from other magical jobs?
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
好吧，这倒是显而易见的。
当然，妖术师也会使用魔法。但是，你知道妖术师与其他魔法职业的主要区别是什么吗？

scripts.text: They know how to sing.
scripts.translation: 他们知道怎么唱歌。

scripts.text: They're all old fogies.
scripts.translation: 他们都是一群老古董。

scripts.text: They can deal with the spirits.
scripts.translation: 他们能与精灵沟通。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Well maybe some but that's not the main difference.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
嗯，也许有些人可以，但这并不是主要区别。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
What! How dare you!?!
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
什么！你竟敢如此无礼？！

scripts.text:
[Merito]
That's right. That is the most distinguishing feature that Sorcerers have.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
没错。这就是妖术师最显著的特征。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
When the people who want to be a Sorcerer come, the first thing we do is to check whether they can communicate with spirits or not.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
当想要成为妖术师的人来的时候，我们首先会检查他们是否能与精灵沟通。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
So that's the basic introduction, so you just need to decide whether or not you want to take the qualification test.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
以上就是基本介绍，现在你需要决定是否参加资格测试。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Well, it's all up to you. What are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
好吧，这完全由你决定。你打算怎么做？

scripts.text: I will take the test.
scripts.translation: 我要参加测试。

scripts.text: I'll do it later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
Okay. 
Then I'll hand it over to Karacas who is on the 4th floor. He will guide you through the process of the test.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
好的。
那么我会把你交给在4楼的卡拉卡斯。他会指导你完成测试流程。

scripts.text:
[Merito]
What? I was sure that you wanted to become a Sorcerer.
scripts.translation:
[梅里托]
什么？我还以为你想成为妖术师呢。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Oh, it seems that you're too heavy. Empty your bag and then come again.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
哦，看来你太重了。清空你的背包，然后再来。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
You look happy. Have a great journey.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
你看起来很开心。祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Is there anything I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
有什么我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
I belong to the Sorcerer association. I don't think you have any business with me.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
我隶属于妖术师协会。我想您应该没有事找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
More people are visiting Geffen Tower these days.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
最近来中央塔的人变多了。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
....
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Oh, you have all the materials.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
哦，您材料都备齐了。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Before I let you know the progressing way, you'll need to bring some required material.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
在我告诉您进阶的方法之前，您需要先准备一些必要的材料。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Wow~ your skill is good.
I thought you'd be overwhelmed by the spirits but you've managed to get the effective medicine!
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
哇~ 您的技术真不错。
我以为您会被精灵们搞得焦头烂额，没想到您竟然成功获取了有效的药剂！

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
It's not an easy thing to get the desired effect by communicating with spirits.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
通过与精灵沟通来获得想要的效果，并不是件容易的事。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Originally my teacher needs to check the Sorcerer job change but after he went out to find the spirit of fish, I can't see him. So I'll check it myself.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
原本需要我的老师来审核妖术师的转职，但他外出寻找鱼的灵魂了，我找不到他。所以由我来审核吧。

scripts.text: [Karacas]
scripts.translation: [卡拉卡斯]

scripts.text: Ah... excuse me~
scripts.translation: 啊...打扰了~

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
... (Z z z~)
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
... (呼噜呼噜~)

scripts.text: Hm hm!!!~

[Karacas]
Aaaak!! 
Oh, my...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
啊啊啊!!
哎呀，我的...

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Wh... where are you from?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
你...你是从哪里来的？

scripts.text: Merito told me to visit you.
scripts.translation: 梅里托让我来找你。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
I see, give me a moment.
The list... has already arrived.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
明白了，请稍等。
名单...已经送来了。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
So, you are [{0}]... right?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
那么，您是[{0}]...对吧？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是。

scripts.text: No, I'm not!
scripts.translation: 不，我不是！

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Oh, there must be some mistake in the list, I think. Will you come again later?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
哦，看来名单上有些错误。您稍后再来一趟好吗？

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Before you take the Sorcerer test, let me give you the basic information.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
在您参加妖术师考试之前，让我先向您介绍一些基本信息。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
The way to get a Sorcerer registration ticket is really simple. You just need to go and find one of each spirit scattered around the world, and then convert their power into the shape of a certain material.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
获取妖术师注册券的方法其实很简单。您只需要去世界各地寻找每种精灵，然后将它们的力量转化为特定材料的形态。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Sounds easy, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
听起来很简单，对吧？

scripts.text: Ahh... sir. Is that really possible?
scripts.translation: 啊...先生，这真的可能吗？

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Well, it is impossible to meet every spirit by yourself. You need to train yourself very hard to give a shape to the spirits and see them clearly through your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
嗯，仅凭你自己是不可能遇到所有精灵的。你需要刻苦修炼，赋予精灵形态，并透过双眼清晰地看见它们。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
So, usually we perform a certain ceremony parade toward the place where we can feel the spirits.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
因此，通常我们会举行某种仪式游行，前往能感受到精灵气息的地方。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
I will tell you how to do that. So listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
我会告诉你该怎么做。请仔细听好。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Usually we cannot see the spirits with our eyes but there is a way to realize the part of the spirits through a special medium.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
通常我们无法用肉眼看到精灵，但通过特殊的媒介，可以感知到精灵的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
For example, if you visit the place where the spirit of wind stays with a certain amount of Wind of Verdure, the reaction of the spirit is amplified.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
例如，如果你携带一定数量的风灵矿石前往风精灵栖息的地方，精灵的反应会被放大。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Likewise, if you approach the place where the spirit of fire seems to stay while you have a certain amount of Red Blood, the spirit will show the adverse reaction.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
同样地，如果你携带一定数量的火灵矿石接近火精灵似乎停留的地方，精灵会表现出强烈的排斥反应。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Sorcerers use this basic principle, this is the essential knowledge that Sorcerers need to have to reach the spirits.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
妖术师利用这一基本原理，这是妖术师必须掌握的基础知识，以便与精灵沟通。

scripts.text: So communicating with spirits...
scripts.translation: 所以是与精灵沟通...

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Right~
This job is based on the power of spirits.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
没错~
这个职业是基于精灵的力量。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Hmm, but it might be hard for someone like you who's focused only on reading books...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
嗯，但对于像你这样只专注于读书的人来说，可能有点难...

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
First, you need to bring the following materials needed for the test.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
首先，你需要准备考试所需的以下材料。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
3 Wind of Verdure.
3 Crystal Blue.
3 Red Blood.
3 Green Live.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
3 风灵矿石。
3 水灵矿石。
3 火灵矿石。
3 地灵矿石。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
When you bring these materials, I'll tell you the next step.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
当你带来这些材料后，我会告诉你下一步该怎么做。

scripts.text: What should I do next?
scripts.translation: 接下来我该做什么？

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
I'll tell you about it now. First, I'll tell you the places for the test. You better write them down.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
我现在就告诉你。首先，我会告诉你考试的地点。你最好把它们记下来。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
1. 1st floor of Ice Cave
2. 1st floor of Thor Volcano Dungeon
3. 3rd floor of Mjolnir Dead Pit
4. 2nd floor of Kunlun Dungeon
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
1. 冰洞 1层
2. 雷神火山地下城 1层
3. 妙勒尼尔死亡之坑 3层
4. 昆仑地下城 2层

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
We have set up the detecting poles in these 4 places so that ordinary people can communicate with the spirits.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
我们在这4个地方设置了探测柱，这样普通人就能与精灵沟通了。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Be aware that these detecting poles are activated only when you have more than the certain amount of property stones.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
请注意，只有当你的属性石数量达到一定标准时，这些探测柱才会被激活。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
You need to prepare at least 3 small stones for each property. For example, you need Wind of Verdure, not Rough Wind.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
你需要为每种属性至少准备3颗小石头。例如，你需要的是风灵矿石，而不是风灵原石。

scripts.text: So I need the property stones...
scripts.translation: 所以我需要属性石...

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Yes, you have quick wits!
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
没错，你很聪明！

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Once you bring the stones to the poles, put them into the property decomposing machine which is attached to the pole. The detecting pole will be activated, and you can communicate with the spirit.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
当你把石头带到探测柱那里，将它们放入连接在柱子上的属性分解机中。探测柱就会被激活，你就可以与精灵沟通了。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
If you succeed, you can extract a part of the spirit as a reagent. If you fail, the property stone will break up.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
如果你成功了，就能提取出精灵的一部分作为试剂。如果失败了，属性石就会碎裂。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Of course if you are lucky enough, if you fail, a Wind of Verdure can be changed into a Rough Wind... Well, that's not a common situation so let's leave that out of the discussion for now.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
当然，如果你运气够好，即使失败了，风灵矿石也可能变成风灵原石... 嗯，这种情况并不常见，所以我们先不讨论这个。

scripts.text: What if I run out of stones?
scripts.translation: 如果我的石头用完了怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Ahahaha... If you run out of property stones, you simply have to get more.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
啊哈哈... 如果你的属性石用完了，你只需要再获取更多。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
So people who have this test usually start with as many property stones as they can carry. The amount I told you to get is just the bare minimum.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
所以参加这个测试的人通常会尽可能多地携带属性石。我让你准备的数量只是最低限度。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
If you are an advanced Sorcerer, you will be able to talk with spirits without going through this process again. But beginners need to use that kind of medium to talk with them.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
如果你是高级妖术师，你将能够不经过这个过程直接与精灵交谈。但初学者需要使用这种媒介来与它们沟通。

scripts.text: So the reagent is...?
scripts.translation: 所以试剂是...

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
We don't know which reagent is going to be made from the spirits. It differs by the state of spirits.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
我们不知道精灵会制造出哪种试剂。这取决于精灵的状态。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
When you succeed in getting 3 different kinds of reagents, you can come back.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
当你成功获得3种不同的试剂后，就可以回来了。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
A reagent that one spirit makes won't be over 2 kinds so if you're going to make 3 kinds of reagents, I suggest you go around several places.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
一个精灵制造的试剂不会超过2种，所以如果你要制造3种试剂，我建议你去几个不同的地方。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
还有问题吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Please explain it again.
scripts.translation: 请再解释一遍。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Haha, then can I have a cup of water for a minute? Please come and find me again later.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
哈哈，那我能不能先喝杯水？请稍后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Then I'll write down the progress that I've summarized shortly. Wait...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
那我马上把总结的进度写下来。等一下...

scripts.text: ^000099You got a paper on which the way of communicating with spirits is written. For more information please open your quest window^000000.
scripts.translation: ^000099你获得了一张写有与精灵沟通方法的纸张。详情请打开任务窗口查看^000000。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
3 Wind of Verdure.
3 Crystal Blue.
3 Red Blood.
3 Green Live.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
3 风灵矿石。
3 水灵矿石。
3 火灵矿石。
3 地灵矿石。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
When you bring these basic things, I'll guide you to the next step.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
当你准备好这些基础物品后，我会指引你进入下一阶段。

scripts.text: Is this all I need to do?
scripts.translation: 这就是我需要做的全部吗？

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Well done. First, I will organize the miraculous medicine so please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
做得好。首先，我要整理一下奇迹药剂，请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Don't give up and keep on trying~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
不要放弃，继续尝试吧~

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Dear [{0}],
you went around the rough wilds to open the door as a Sorcerer and passed all the requirements that our Academy has given.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
亲爱的[{0}]，
你穿越了荒野，作为妖术师打开了大门，并通过了我们学院设定的所有要求。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Of course it is just a beginning, we don't know which spirit you're going to commune with or what kind of hardships await you.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
当然，这只是个开始，我们还不知道你会与哪位精灵沟通，也不知道未来会面临怎样的艰难险阻。

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
But with the ability you've shown until now, you will be capable to do anything from now on. Dear [{0}]
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
但以你目前展现出的能力，从今往后你将无所不能。亲爱的[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Kalakas]
Before I appointed you the need job, please check on your own body status.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
在我任命你为尼德之前，请先检查一下自身的身体状态。

scripts.text:
[Kalakas]
Good, before we get started...
Please unequip your riding pet~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
很好，在我们开始之前...
请卸下你的坐骑~

scripts.text:
[Kalakas]
Moreover, I formally acknowledge that you've completed all the job transfer tests of the Sorcerer Academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
此外，我正式确认你已完成妖术师学院的所有转职测试。

scripts.text:
[Kalakas]
You must have the etiquette of your job now before you accept the new job!
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
在接受新职业之前，你必须具备该职业的礼仪！

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
Congratulations, [{0}]
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
恭喜你，[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Karacas]
I hope that you gain more communion with spirits from now on.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉卡斯]
希望从今往后，你能与精灵建立更深的沟通。

scripts.text: You got a reagent by communicating with an unseen spirit.
scripts.translation: 你通过与隐形精灵沟通获得了一种试剂。

scripts.text: It doesn't seem like you got anything special from the spirits.
scripts.translation: 看起来你并没有从精灵那里获得什么特别的东西。

scripts.text: You got a reagent by communicating with an unseen spirit.
scripts.translation: 你通过与隐形精灵沟通获得了一种试剂。

scripts.text: It doesn't seem like you got anything special from the spirits.
scripts.translation: 看起来你并没有从精灵那里获得什么特别的东西。

scripts.text: The spirit combined the property stones into a huge property stone.
scripts.translation: 精灵将属性石融合成了一块巨大的属性石。

scripts.text: You used the property stones but it looks like you failed to communicate with the spirits.
scripts.translation: 你使用了属性石，但看起来你未能与精灵沟通成功。

scripts.text: I can see the detecting staff that's been installed by the Sorcerer Union to communicate with the spirits.
scripts.translation: 我能看到由妖术师公会安装用于与精灵沟通的感测魔杖。

scripts.text: If you have the suitable property stones, you should be able to commune with the spirits.
scripts.translation: 如果你拥有合适的属性石，应该就能与精灵沟通了。
